extends Node

# Manual integration test: load main, simulate Player collecting Coin, check persistence.

func _ready() -> void:
    var root := get_tree().root
    var scene := preload("res://scenes/Main.tscn").instantiate()
    root.add_child(scene)
    await get_tree().process_frame
    await get_tree().process_frame

    # Initial state
    assert(Inventory.get_count() == 0)

    # Find the coin and trigger collection manually
    var coin = scene.get_node("Coin")
    assert(coin != null)
    # coin._on_body_entered takes an Area2D/Node2D. Pass player area.
    var player = scene.get_node("Player")
    coin._on_body_entered(player)

    # Wait for frame after queue_free
    await get_tree().process_frame
    await get_tree().process_frame

    var saved = FileAccess.get_file_as_string("user://save.json")
    print("saved inventory: ", saved)
    assert(Inventory.get_count() == 1)
    assert("{\"count\": 1}" in saved)

    print("ALL ASSERTIONS PASSED")
    get_tree().quit(0)
